lines.text: Elisha sends a young prophet to Ramoth-gilead with a flask of oil to anoint Jehu king over Israel.
Jehu goes into the house, where the young prophet pours oil on his head and anoints him king.
The LORD tells Jehu to strike down the house of Saul to avenge the blood of His prophets.
The LORD says the dogs will devour Jezebel on the plot of ground at Samaria, and the young prophet runs.
After Jehu tells the servants what the LORD said, each man puts his garment under Jehu and they proclaim him king.
